name: t3_binary_sdar_grouplink
description: Plain-family binary (no stellar evolution) with the pairwise force pinned in the Hermite hard channel (r_in = 0.02 > r_apo); the mass-weighted AR linking criterion gives three verified regimes (census from whole-run group event dumps): never grouped (r_group=0.002, pure Hermite pair), stable group (r_group=0.018, pure AR, never breaks), and genuine orbit-frequency Hermite-AR switching (r_group=0.013, criterion inside the separation range: ~1 break/re-form per orbit, level between the two channels, stationary).

checks.name: census_never_grouped
checks.comment: T3-a (pure Hermite): no group formation events at all (0 form events in the whole-run group dump)

checks.name: census_stable_group_no_break
checks.comment: T3-b (pure AR): r_group = 0.018 > r_apo, mass-weighted r_crit above apocenter - the group forms once and never breaks (0 break events)

checks.name: census_switching_occurs
checks.comment: T3-c (Hermite-AR switching): r_group = 0.013 places the criterion inside the separation range - genuine orbit-frequency switching, ~1 break/re-form per orbit (measured 110 over 113 orbits); >=50 catches a silent regression to stable/never-grouped

checks.name: census_switching_no_explosion
checks.comment: T3-c guard: the pre-fix bug produced step-frequency chatter (411k break/re-form cycles per run, dynamically invisible); the healthy switching is ~1/orbit (113), so >2000 events flags the chatter recurrence

checks.name: switching_no_worse_than_hermite_pair
checks.comment: T3-c: pericenter grouping pays off - the switching run conserves better than the never-grouped Hermite pair (measured ~0.13x)

checks.name: energy_error_stationary_outside_apo
checks.comment: T3-b (always grouped): per-period error envelope stationary over ~113 orbits

checks.name: energy_error_stationary_between
checks.comment: T3-c: the per-orbit link/unlink switching introduces no secular energy drift (measured rho ~0.17)

checks.name: energy_error_stationary_inside_peri
checks.comment: T3-a (never grouped, Hermite pair): stationary error over ~113 orbits

checks.name: pure_ar_error_bound
checks.comment: T3-b accuracy: the stable AR group integrates the isolated binary essentially exactly (measured ~6.2e-12); above 1e-11 the regularized integration itself is degrading

checks.name: pure_hermite_error_bound
checks.comment: T3-a accuracy: the never-grouped Hermite pair (block-step truncation, measured ~4.7e-7) stays below 1e-6; above it the block-step channel is degrading
